decisions.rationale: G6PD Orissa names a specific enzyme variant (allele) of G6PD rather than a disease mention; the disease in the text is G6PD deficiency, so this variant name is not annotated as a disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease must be a disease mention); What NOT to Annotate §1

decisions.rationale: Refers to glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, a single specific disease with no further categorization.
Abbreviation in parentheses for the long form Deficiency of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase, which denotes the same disease; synonymous mention annotated separately.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §6 (synonymous mentions and abbreviations)

decisions.rationale: Malaria is a specific, single disease named in the text (areas where malaria has been endemic).
G6PD deficiency is a specific disease mention referring to the enzyme deficiency condition, not to a general term.
In heterogeneity of G6PD, the term refers to the enzyme or gene being studied, not to a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease must be a disease mention)

decisions.rationale: Screening for G6PD deficiency refers to the specific disease G6PD deficiency.
The frequency of G6PD deficiency refers to the specific disease G6PD deficiency.
G6PD Orissa is a named enzyme variant (a deficient allele) rather than a disease name; the disease mention is the G6PD deficiency it causes.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease must be a disease mention); What NOT to Annotate §1

decisions.rationale: Most of the G6PD deficiency in tribal Indian populations refers to the specific disease G6PD deficiency.
The G6PD deficiency in urban populations refers to the specific disease G6PD deficiency.
G6PD Mediterranean names an enzyme variant with a specific amino acid substitution, not a disease name; it is not annotated as a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate §1 (Specific Disease must be a disease mention); What NOT to Annotate §1

decisions.rationale: G6PD Orissa here refers to the enzyme variant and its kinetic property (KmNADP), not to a disease mention.
